    Help

    Press Upper: it grows on the last. Paint changes its region; Midsole and Outsole grow the same way.

    With Paint lit, a drag on the piece paints and a drag beside it turns the view; Orbit only turns it.

    What this is

    A parametric shoe-last designer. A last is the mold a shoe is built around. Everything grades from a real foot length with published lastmaking math.

    Sizing

    EU, UK, US or Mondopoint (cm), converted through foot length (ISO 19407). Fitting is the width: eleven steps of 3/16 inch of ball girth.

    Last length is the foot plus the toe allowance: 15mm for a standard shoe, none for a sandal.

    Generator

    Warp bends a reference last through nine functions, graded from the size chart.

    Shaping the last

    Last type sets heel, toe spring, toe shape, vamp and allowance together. Personality overlays it; Foot morphology nudges width and toe box. Shape overrides one value; a pencil mark shows it, Reset returns it.

    Views

    Side (the lateral side), Plan, Back, Front, 3/4, Under, Section, Turn, Render and Fit; Perspective switches to orthographic. Measure with the Measure tool, not a screenshot.

    Girth

    Ball girth is the fitting dimension. Solve to the charted ball girth (on by default) changes the forepart’s depth only; length, ball width and height hold. With it on, the Ball girth slider is the target. Off, the mesh runs over the chart.

    Bottom pattern

    The last’s maximum outline from below, SVG at 1:1 with a 50mm check bar. Not the feather edge. The dashed line is the ball, where the mesh is widest.

    Forme

    The side flattened: inside, outside and mean forme, SVG at 1:1. The drawing states the stretch left in it.

    Forme (DXF, 1:1): a cutting die, the mean forme as AutoCAD R12 DXF in millimeters: the cut line, an 8 mm seam allowance, alignment notches, a grainline, and a verdict on how far a TPU skin stretches over it.

    Import a last

    An STL or OBJ last, oriented from its geometry, measured with the same instruments as yours. A reference only: in no export and no saved file.

    Compare

    A second last in yellow over yours: another size, another type, the girth solve on or off, or an import. Not part of the document; Measure ignores it.

    File

    The name at the top right is the document: . It autosaves in this browser as you work; a purple dot means changes since its last save to a file. New shoe and Open never lose anything: the document you leave waits in Recent, with a picture. Save (⌘S) writes the .lastfirst file, back to the same file where the browser allows it; Save as (⇧⌘S) picks a new one. Rename it at the top of the menu.

    Zellerfeld submission

    In Make › Submit: reads Zellerfeld’s mandatory rules on this shoe (one body, watertight, no crossing faces, a collar that splits inside from outside, overhangs at their 120° print tilt, sole height, the upper’s wall). Load their last (your own download of their template) and Fit is checked too: the shoe is carried from this last onto theirs, its inside within 0.5 mm. Submission files writes both feet’s shoe and collar STLs; their last stays in this tab.

    Size run

    Lasts (OBJ) writes the graded set as one file, one group per size. Spec CSV lists charted and measured girth per size.

    Shoe size run (Make › Size run) grades the whole shoe: each size regrades the last and regrows every piece from the same paint, then writes or into one zip with a spec CSV. The shoe is left as it was.

    Shoe

    Idioshoe design built in pieces on the last, foot to floor: , , , and . The top row tracks pieces and ends at : print, files, the size run and Zellerfeld. Size, type and shape live on the Last. Selecting a grown piece displays its dials in the right HUD.

    Upper: fitted to the last with slip-on, clog, or mule forms: , , . Adjust , , , , and . The toe: or ; an open back takes a . cut the upper into straps. punch round holes through it, a field or a brogue row in from the rim; the pitch is held where the piece’s mesh cannot cut closer. The holes go into STL, OBJ and 3MF, and the print. A SuperB (.unreason, .3dm) is the unpunched piece, with each hole beside it on a perforations layer: a circle in Unreason, a cylinder through the wall in Rhino (ToNURBS the SubD, then BooleanDifference). The way-in test sweeps the entry path to verify foot insertion before printing.

    Midsole: a Terrainer hung under the foot down to the ground. Set , , , , , , , and . Body options include with , , and . Terrain sculptures include (stalactites), (rounded tips), , and (Three, Five, Summits). Draw plan outlines with .

    Outsole: unified plate under contact pads and stalactite tips: , , and (twelve patterns as swatches, Carved or Raised, a Round, V or Square groove section; picking a pattern sets the suggested section and says why; Where lays it only on a painted Color, Edge curve shapes the soft edge, and a Border cuts a band round the rim. Flex grooves cross the ball line at a pitch from their width, depth and the Bend at which they close), and (Fuzzy sides: the slicer’s fuzzy skin on the outsole’s outer walls).

    The terrain places are real heightfields. A place wraps once round the sole, seam at the heel; the readout gives its scale as N× life.

    Layers: stack Shell, Puff, Terrainer, or Pipe forms on substrates: , , and . Pipe elements include continuous tube, spaced beads, grommet eyelets, zipper teeth, crisscross laces and chain.

    Print: prepare production prints with , , , , and . The estimate notes an open piece and a stack past the box.

    The rail holds what applies: , and on the Last; Orbit, , , and on a piece. Color, Gap and Points are Paint it in their effects. Views: , , , , , , , , and ; switches to orthographic.

    The Line puts points on the painted edge. Drag one, press the line twice to add one, , or the whole edge.

    Sculpt

    Freehand brushes, stored as a delta that survives size and preset changes, one per generator. Off while subdivision is on.

    Mesh ops

    Subdivision and smoothing run after sculpt and never alter the document. Both pull the surface in slightly.

    Measuring

    Measure is a caliper; Wrap follows the surface along mesh edges. The measured girth line reads the mesh at its widest section.

    Files

    The last, any shoe piece, or the whole shoe, as STL, OBJ, .unreason, .3dm, 1:1 SVG patterns, and a Turn video. The 3MF for a slicer is in Print.

    About

    ⟨McCONNELLMESHES⟩

    Generative 3D Footwear Design & 3D Print Studio

    A fully customizable shoe creation suite built for additive manufacturing. Calibrate a last directly to your foot, grow parametric shoes with custom wall thicknesses, perforations/vents, surface topography, and automated 3D printability checks.
